## Who is SoCal BOOM for?

The meeting is for people interested in marine biogeochemistry, including
students, postdoctoral researchers, faculty, researchers, and undergraduates.
The program spans observational, experimental, proxy-based, theoretical, and
modeling approaches.

## Who may submit an abstract?

At the 2027 meeting, oral and poster presentations were open to graduate
students and postdoctoral researchers. Eligibility for the next meeting will
be confirmed on the [Abstracts](scientific-program/abstracts.qmd) page.

## Do I need to present in order to attend?

No. Previous meetings welcomed attendees who were not presenting, including
undergraduates, faculty, and other researchers.

## What presentation formats are offered?

The 2027 program included full-length talks, five-minute lightning talks, and
posters. See [For Presenters](scientific-program/for-presenters.qmd) for the
previous format specifications and future updates.

## How large can a poster be?

The 2027 maximum was 45 × 45 inches, with 45 × 36-inch horizontal posters also
accepted. The next meeting's board dimensions will be confirmed before
presenters print their posters. Updates will be posted on
[For Presenters](scientific-program/for-presenters.qmd).

## Is there a registration fee?

The archived site did not specify a fee. Current registration terms will be
posted on the [Register](register.qmd) page.

## Is attendance limited?

The 2027 meeting capped registration at 120 people. The capacity for the next
meeting has not been announced.

## Where will the meeting take place?

The 2027 meeting will be held in UKNOWN LOCATION at USC. 
[Travel & Logistics](travel-logistics.qmd) for venue information and
future updates.

## Will food be provided?

The 2027 schedule includes refreshments, lunch, and an informal off-campus
dinner. Food arrangements and dietary-accommodation instructions for the next
meeting have not yet been posted.

## Where can I ask another question?

Use the information on the [Contact Us](contact.qmd) page.
